game[title]: GameMaker Library: 84 GML Assets, Plus Every New One
game[short_text]: All 84 CSAF GameMaker assets in one download. Every new one is added free.
game[description]:
Every paid CSAF asset for GameMaker in one download: 84 pure GML assets worth $1,071.16 bought one by one, for $19.99, plus every new one on its launch day.

Each asset sits in its own folder exactly as its own page delivers it: its .yymps package, its own Readme and LICENSE, and a runnable demo room. 84 packages and 778 GML scripts, no extensions or DLLs, royalty free in commercial games. 80 folders also carry the readable project, so you can open the source before importing.

How the future assets work

  • When a new CSAF GameMaker asset comes out, its files are added to this page on launch day.
  • You pay once. Open your itch.io library and the new files are there.
  • Every addition gets a devlog post here, so follow the page to hear about it.

Latest additions

  • 2026-11-10: Quizmaster, new here first: a game show quiz written from your own records, with exactly one right answer to every question, rival contestants who buzz in, six drawn stages and a solo exam mode. The third of three Arcade Cabinet minigames.
  • 2026-11-08: Schuss, new here first: SkiFree style downhill runs in five modes (ski, snowboard, sled, mine cart, raft) and three goals, on courses generated from a seed, every course ridden once by the autopilot before your game gets it. The second of three Arcade Cabinet minigames.
  • 2026-11-07: Pegfall, new here first: peg boards generated from a seed in ten layouts and six drawn themes, every board proven clearable, and an aim guide that runs the shot's own physics. The first of three Arcade Cabinet minigames.
  • 2026-11-07: Chitin, Colosseum and Taproom 1.1.0. Each has its own script prefix now, so every asset here can share one project.
  • 2026-11-06: the library opens with 84 assets.

What is inside (84 assets)

Items, gear, crafting and trade (10 assets, $130.90): Trove, Athanor, Panoply, Bourse, Repast, Lode, Armoury, Hallmark, Bracket, Haversack.

Characters, creatures and nature (10 assets, $133.90): Forage, Menagerie, Verdure, Shoal, Effigy, Chitin, Raiment, Liege, Masque, Vivarium.

Worlds, skies and places (9 assets, $117.91): Charter, Welkin, Borough, Hearth, Muster, Touchpaper, Neon, Voyage, Cloudshadow.

Combat, spells and battle (7 assets, $97.93): Grimoire, Affliction, Adversary, Barrage, Colosseum, Bivouac, Battalia.

Effects and game feel (5 assets, $50.95): Beacon, Pliant, Horologe, Hurrah, Halation.

Menus, interface and documents (11 assets, $155.89): Kinetic UI, Meridian, Vestige, Livery, Colophon, Missive, Frontispiece, Intertitle, Wanted, Cartouche, Folio.

Story, quests and systems (11 assets, $138.89): Crest, Lexicon, Dossier, Almanac, Chronicle, Psyche, Branchwork, Arras, Song Sheets, Loopwork, Tether.

Minigames and game modes (21 assets, $244.79): Facet, Pastime, Puzzlework, Derby, Sampler, Tray, Anvil, Taproom, Scales, Strata, Jigsaw, Jackpot, Table Service, Chicane, Pendant, Escapement, Fairway, Unveil, Pegfall, Schuss, Quizmaster.

Forage was sold on this page before it became the library; it is inside, in its own folder. The download carries CATALOGUE.md with one line per asset.

Works with

GameMaker, built and tested on runtime 2024.14. Import an asset with Tools, Import Local Package, then run the demo room its Readme names. Each asset prefixes its scripts, objects, macros and globals with its own short name, and no two assets share a name, so any of them can go into one project.

The price

$19.99 now. The price rises as the library grows; buyers keep every asset that joins.

Try it free

Two free pages from the same studio: Drawn in Code, a free sampler of the generated look, and Loom, capes, hair and ropes that follow a sprite.

Licence and how it was made

You can use every asset in commercial and non-commercial GameMaker projects, in any number of projects, with no royalty, and modify the source for your own games. You can't redistribute the source or the packages as an asset pack or collection. LICENSE.txt in the download covers the whole library.

Made with AI tools: the code and the store images. No narrative text is included.

For anything, post a comment below. If the library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

Made by Core Systems Asset Factory.
